symmetry_table.protocol: Proper cube rotations recorded by placement_verify_part_symmetries; vertex level compares universal CAD vertex sets, triangle level compares full colored triangle sets; printed moulds keep identity only
symmetry_table.limitations: Embossed stud logo orientation and triangle tessellation are outside the vertex level. A part with no saved proof is treated as having no symmetry, which understates equivalence rather than overstating it.

scope: Independent OMR evaluation only. Authoritative filename aliases and declared unprinted structural symmetries reported separately from raw strict score. No evaluation chooses runtime output.
